messages:
jordan (design): quick thing for review — proposal to reorganize left nav into contextual groups (Workloads, Models, Deployments, Billing) and make each group link preserve the current filter/tab state. goal: fewer accidental context drops when users switch sections. thoughts?

marta (ux): i like fewer surprises. main UX question: when a user switches group should we keep the detail panel open if the selected item exists in the new context? e.g., model details -> clicking Deployments shouldn't show model sidepanel.

eli (eng): agree. technical plan: encode selection + filters into the URL so switching groups uses pushState and rehydrates. can implement `?tab=activity&sel=model:abc123&f=quantized` or a compact token `?s=Zx2` that maps to state.

sam (frontend): prefer explicit params to start (easier to debug and instrument). we can later add a shortlink service for `Share view` copies. also need to decide which interactions use replaceState vs pushState to avoid polluting history.

lina (product): telemetry note: add a `ctx` param like `ctx=nav` vs `ctx=embed` so we can see how people reach deep links. also want to ensure saved views remain stable when we change param names in future.

arun (a11y): accessibility: whenever the URL rehydrates UI, we must move focus to the top landmark and announce via aria-live the restored state ("Showing deployments, 4 filters applied"). keyboard users expect focus continuity.

jordan (design): breadcrumb behavior idea: breadcrumbs should reflect group + section + selected resource. e.g., "Models / Versions / resnet-50" — clicking any crumb navigates and preserves sibling filters.

marta (ux): breadcrumb click should act like nav click (preserve filters) unless the crumb targets a higher-level view where filters are irrelevant. maybe a tooltip: "Navigate and preserve filters" on hover.

eli (eng): routing edgecases: legacy external links may include only a resource id (no context). router should attempt to resolve resource -> open in default context (and add `resolved_from=legacy_link` to analytics).

sam (frontend): implementation sketch:
```js
// parse URL on load -> if sel param exists, fetch resource, open panel, focus heading
// on nav clicks -> build param set for new route and pushState
// small interactions -> replaceState
```

lina (product): copy tweak: change permalink action text from "Copy link" to "Copy view link" and for saved views use "Save view". helps set expectations.

arun (a11y): another small thing: avoid using hash-only routing for state that affects semantics; use query params so AT can parse URLs consistently.

jordan (design): ok next steps: sam to draft router RFC with history strategy + crumb contract, arun to propose aria copy strings, eli to research tokenized shortlinks for long filter sets, marta to wireframe group behavior. i'll schedule a 30m sync on Tue.

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: nav-ia-experiment -> staging on 2024-07-02T09:00UTC :rocket:
